question_en: Which country won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026, co-hosted by India and Sri Lanka?
explanation_en: India beat New Zealand by 96 runs in the final on 8 March 2026 at Ahmedabad, becoming the first team to win three T20 World Cup titles.

question_en: The final of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 was played at which venue?
explanation_en: The 8 March 2026 final between India and New Zealand was held at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad.

question_en: Who was named Player of the Tournament at the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026?
explanation_en: Sanju Samson topped the batting with 321 runs at an average of about 80; Bumrah was Player of the Match in the final (4/15).

question_en: Whom did India defeat in the final of the ICC Women's ODI World Cup 2025 to win its first title?
explanation_en: India beat South Africa by 52 runs at DY Patil Stadium, Navi Mumbai on 2 November 2025.

question_en: Who captained India's women's team to the 2025 ICC Women's ODI World Cup triumph?
explanation_en: Harmanpreet Kaur led India to its maiden Women's World Cup title in November 2025 (earlier finals lost in 2005 and 2017).

question_en: Which franchise won the IPL 2026 title, defending the crown it won in 2025?
explanation_en: RCB beat Gujarat Titans by five wickets in the final at Ahmedabad, their second consecutive title.

question_en: Who won the Orange Cap in IPL 2026 with 776 runs?
explanation_en: Teenage opener Vaibhav Sooryavanshi finished as the leading run-scorer of IPL 2026 with 776 runs; Kagiso Rabada took the Purple Cap (29 wickets).

question_en: Which country won the FIFA World Cup 2026?
explanation_en: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final at MetLife Stadium on 19 July 2026, their second World Cup after 2010.

question_en: The FIFA World Cup 2026, the first with 48 teams, was jointly hosted by:
explanation_en: FIFA's first three-nation World Cup was co-hosted by the USA, Canada and Mexico, with the final in New Jersey.

question_en: Who scored the only goal in the FIFA World Cup 2026 final?
explanation_en: Ferran Torres scored in the 106th minute of extra time to give Spain a 1-0 win over Argentina.

question_en: The 2026 Asian Games were held in which Japanese region?
explanation_en: The 20th Asian Games were held at Aichi-Nagoya, Japan from 19 September to 4 October 2026.

question_en: How many medals did India win at the 2026 Asian Games (Aichi-Nagoya), finishing fourth in the table?
explanation_en: India won 85 medals (21 gold, 27 silver, 37 bronze); its record 107 medals came at Hangzhou 2022.

question_en: Which country topped the medal table at the 2026 Asian Games?
explanation_en: China topped the Asian Games medal table yet again, with Japan second and South Korea third.

question_en: The XXV Olympic Winter Games, held in February 2026, were hosted by:
explanation_en: The 2026 Winter Olympics were co-hosted by Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo in Italy; the next Winter Games (2030) go to the French Alps.

question_en: Which country finished first in the medal table of the 2026 Winter Olympics?
explanation_en: Norway topped the table with 18 golds and 41 medals; the USA was second and the Netherlands third.

question_en: Which Indian city has been awarded the 2030 Commonwealth Games, the centenary edition?
explanation_en: The Commonwealth Sport General Assembly in Glasgow (Nov 2025) chose Ahmedabad over Abuja; India last hosted in Delhi in 2010.

question_en: Who won the men's singles title at Wimbledon 2026?
explanation_en: Sinner defended his Wimbledon title, beating Alexander Zverev in four sets in the July 2026 final.

question_en: Who won the women's singles title at Wimbledon 2026, her first Grand Slam singles title?
explanation_en: The 9th-seeded Czech Linda Noskova beat compatriot Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3.

question_en: Who won the men's singles title at the Australian Open 2026 by beating Novak Djokovic in the final?
explanation_en: Alcaraz won his first Australian Open title in January-February 2026, completing a career Grand Slam.

question_en: The 60th Jnanpith Award (for 2025), announced in March 2026, was given to which writer?
explanation_en: Tamil poet-lyricist R. Vairamuthu won the 2025 Jnanpith, becoming the first Tamil poet to receive it; the award carries Rs 11 lakh and a Vagdevi statuette.

question_en: The 59th Jnanpith Award (for 2024) was given to which Hindi writer?
explanation_en: Vinod Kumar Shukla, author of 'Naukar Ki Kameez', received the 59th Jnanpith Award.

question_en: How many persons were honoured with the Padma Awards announced on 25 January 2026?
explanation_en: The 2026 list had 131 awardees (5 Vibhushan, 13 Bhushan, 113 Shri per most reports); 2025 had 139 and 2024 had 132.

question_en: Which veteran actor was honoured posthumously with the Padma Vibhushan in 2026?
explanation_en: Dharmendra and former Kerala CM V. S. Achuthanandan were among the posthumous Padma Vibhushan recipients of 2026.

question_en: Which former tennis star received the Padma Bhushan in 2026?
explanation_en: Vijay Amritraj was among the 2026 Padma Bhushan awardees along with Mammootty, Alka Yagnik and Uday Kotak.

question_en: With the Union Budget 2026-27 presented on 1 February 2026, how many consecutive Union Budgets has Nirmala Sitharaman presented?
explanation_en: The 2026-27 Budget was her ninth in a row, counting the July 2019 budget and both 2024 budgets (interim and full).

question_en: The Union Budget 2026-27 estimated the fiscal deficit for FY 2026-27 at about:
explanation_en: The Budget put the 2026-27 fiscal deficit at 4.3% of GDP, down from 4.4% in the revised estimates for 2025-26.

question_en: The new Income Tax Act, 2025 replacing the Income-tax Act, 1961 came into effect from:
explanation_en: The Income Tax Act, 2025 is in force from 1 April 2026 and introduces 'tax year' in place of previous year/assessment year.

question_en: Which scheme/mission did Union Budget 2026-27 announce as the next phase of India's chip-making push?
explanation_en: Budget 2026-27 announced India Semiconductor Mission 2.0 to deepen the domestic chip ecosystem.

question_en: 'Biopharma SHAKTI', announced in the Union Budget 2026-27, aims to position India as a global hub for:
explanation_en: Biopharma SHAKTI is the Budget 2026-27 initiative to build India into a global biopharmaceutical manufacturing and research hub.

question_en: In its October 2026 policy, the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee raised the repo rate to:
explanation_en: On 7 October 2026 the MPC hiked the repo rate by 25 bps from 5.25% to 5.50%, the first increase since February 2023.

question_en: In October 2026 the MPC changed its policy stance from neutral to:
explanation_en: Along with the 25 bps repo hike, the stance was shifted to 'calibrated tightening'; the SDF rate became 5.25% and MSF 5.75%.

question_en: Who is the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (as of October 2026)?
explanation_en: Sanjay Malhotra took over as the 26th RBI Governor in December 2024 and chairs the MPC.

question_en: The VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 replaced which rural employment law?
explanation_en: The Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act received Presidential assent in Dec 2025 and replaced MGNREGA from 1 July 2026.

question_en: How many days of guaranteed wage employment per rural household per year does the VB-G RAM G Act provide?
explanation_en: The new Act raises the guarantee from 100 days under MGNREGA to 125 days per financial year.

question_en: Under the VB-G RAM G Act, what share of the programme cost do most states have to bear?
explanation_en: Unlike MGNREGA (Centre paid the full wage bill), most states now bear 40%; North-Eastern and Himalayan states bear only 10%.

question_en: Census 2027, whose first phase (houselisting) began in April 2026, is India's first:
explanation_en: Houselisting ran April-September 2026 using mobile apps and online self-enumeration; population enumeration follows in early 2027.

question_en: What is the reference date for population enumeration of Census 2027 in most of India?
explanation_en: The reference date is 00:00 hours of 1 March 2027 (1 October 2026 for snow-bound areas such as Ladakh and Himachal's high-altitude parts).

question_en: Census 2027 will, for the first time since 1931, enumerate which category of data for the whole population?
explanation_en: The Union government decided in 2025 to include caste enumeration in the upcoming Census.

question_en: How many Labour Codes were brought into effect on 21 November 2025, consolidating 29 central labour laws?
explanation_en: The codes on Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security and Occupational Safety, Health & Working Conditions were notified together.

question_en: After the GST reform effective 22 September 2025, the two main GST rate slabs are:
explanation_en: 'GST 2.0' merged 12% and 28% slabs into 5% and 18%, with a special 40% rate for sin and luxury goods.

question_en: India and the European Union announced the conclusion of free trade agreement negotiations in:
explanation_en: The India-EU FTA, called the 'mother of all deals', was concluded on 27 January 2026 after nearly two decades of talks.

question_en: Who were the chief guests at India's 77th Republic Day celebrations in 2026?

options.en: Ursula von der Leyen and Antonio Costa
Joe Biden and Ursula von der Leyen

explanation_en: The Presidents of the European Commission and European Council were the guests of honour on 26 January 2026.

question_en: In February 2026 the US announced an interim trade deal with India reducing its tariff on Indian goods to:
explanation_en: President Trump announced on 2 February 2026 a cut in US reciprocal tariffs on Indian goods to 18%; Modi confirmed the rate.

question_en: Nationwide commemoration of 150 years of which national song began on 7 November 2025?
explanation_en: Vande Mataram, composed by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee in 1875, completed 150 years; the yearlong celebration began on 7 November 2025.

question_en: India observed the 150th birth anniversary of which leader on 31 October 2025, celebrated as Rashtriya Ekta Diwas?
explanation_en: Sardar Patel, born 31 October 1875, was the 'Iron Man of India'; the Statue of Unity honours him.

question_en: Who took oath as the 53rd Chief Justice of India on 24 November 2025?
explanation_en: Justice Surya Kant succeeded Justice B. R. Gavai and is due to retire on 9 February 2027.

question_en: Who is the Vice President of India (elected in September 2025 after Jagdeep Dhankhar's resignation)?
explanation_en: C. P. Radhakrishnan, former Maharashtra Governor, was elected the 15th Vice President on 9 September 2025.

question_en: Who was sworn in as Chief Minister of Bihar for the tenth time after the NDA's win in the November 2025 election?
explanation_en: The NDA won a landslide in the November 2025 Bihar Assembly election and Nitish Kumar took oath on 20 November 2025.

question_en: Which state elected its first BJP government in the Assembly election results declared in May 2026?
explanation_en: The BJP won about 206-207 of 294 seats in West Bengal, ending the Trinamool Congress's 15-year rule; Suvendu Adhikari was sworn in on 9 May 2026.

question_en: Against which sitting Chief Minister did Suvendu Adhikari win the Bhabanipur seat in 2026?
explanation_en: Mamata Banerjee lost Bhabanipur to Suvendu Adhikari by 15,105 votes in the 2026 West Bengal election.

question_en: Vijay, who took oath as Tamil Nadu Chief Minister in May 2026, heads which party?
explanation_en: Actor-politician Vijay's TVK won 107 seats and displaced the DMK; he was sworn in on 10 May 2026 with outside support from allies.

question_en: Who became the Chief Minister of Kerala after the Congress-led UDF's win in the 2026 Assembly election?
explanation_en: The UDF secured a big majority in May 2026 and Congress named V. D. Satheesan as CM.

question_en: Who became the Prime Minister of Bangladesh after the BNP's victory in the February 2026 general election?
explanation_en: The BNP, led by Tarique Rahman, son of Khaleda Zia, won the first election after the 2024 uprising.

question_en: Who became Japan's first woman Prime Minister in October 2025?
explanation_en: Sanae Takaichi of the LDP was elected Prime Minister of Japan in October 2025.

question_en: The Nobel Peace Prize 2025 was awarded to which Venezuelan opposition leader?
explanation_en: Machado was honoured for her work promoting democratic rights in Venezuela (announced 10 October 2025).

question_en: The Nobel Peace Prize 2026 was awarded to which former UN human rights chief of South African origin?
explanation_en: Navi Pillay, also a former ICC and ICJ judge, was announced as the 2026 peace laureate on 9 October 2026.

question_en: The Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences 2026 was awarded to which pair of American economists?

options.en: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford

explanation_en: The Royal Swedish Academy honoured them on 12 October 2026 for their work on macroeconomic stabilisation.

question_en: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2026 was awarded for pioneering work on:
explanation_en: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel were honoured for light-controlled ion channel research.

question_en: India hosted the first global AI summit in the Global South in February 2026. It was called the:
explanation_en: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi ended with the adoption of the New Delhi Declaration on AI Impact.

question_en: The India AI Impact Summit 2026 was organised around three 'Sutras'. These were:
explanation_en: The three foundational pillars of the summit were People, Planet and Progress.

question_en: Which country holds the BRICS chairship for 2026, hosting the 18th summit in New Delhi in September 2026?
explanation_en: India chairs BRICS in 2026 under the theme of resilience, innovation, cooperation and sustainability; Brazil chaired in 2025.

question_en: COP30, the UN climate conference of November 2025, was hosted in which city?
explanation_en: COP30 was held in Belem in the Brazilian Amazon region; COP29 was in Baku and COP28 in Dubai.

question_en: Which country holds the G20 presidency for 2026?
explanation_en: The USA took over the G20 presidency from South Africa (Johannesburg summit, Nov 2025) for 2026.

question_en: Who is the Chief Minister of Delhi (as of October 2026)?
explanation_en: Rekha Gupta of the BJP took oath on 20 February 2025 after the BJP won the Delhi Assembly election, ending AAP's rule.

question_en: Rekha Gupta is the how-manyth woman Chief Minister of Delhi?
explanation_en: After Sushma Swaraj (1998), Sheila Dikshit (1998-2013) and Atishi (2024-25), Rekha Gupta became the fourth woman CM of Delhi.

question_en: The Delhi Budget 2026-27, presented on 24 March 2026, was projected as a:
explanation_en: CM Rekha Gupta presented a roughly Rs 1.04 lakh crore budget with heavy focus on pollution control and environment.

question_en: Who presented the Delhi Budget 2026-27 in the Delhi Assembly?
explanation_en: Rekha Gupta holds the Finance portfolio and presented her second budget on 24 March 2026.

question_en: In the Delhi Budget 2026-27, which sector received the largest allocation (about Rs 19,300 crore)?
explanation_en: Education got about Rs 19,326 crore, followed by health at about Rs 13,034 crore.

question_en: Under the Mahila Samriddhi Yojana approved by the Delhi Cabinet, eligible women are to receive a monthly assistance of:
explanation_en: The BJP's manifesto promise of Rs 2,500 a month was cleared by the Delhi cabinet on 8 March 2025 for women aged 18-60 with limited family income.

question_en: Delhi conducted its first cloud-seeding trial in October 2025 in collaboration with which institution?
explanation_en: The artificial-rain trials aimed at easing post-Diwali smog were conducted with IIT Kanpur using silver iodide and sodium chloride.

question_en: In Census 2027 houselisting, which Delhi areas were among the first to open self-enumeration?
explanation_en: The first self-enumeration phase covered some states/UTs plus areas under NDMC and the Delhi Cantonment Board.

question_en: ISRO's first uncrewed Gaganyaan mission (G1) is to carry which humanoid robot?
explanation_en: Vyommitra, a half-humanoid, will test life-support and re-entry systems; G1 has been targeted for late 2026 (subject to delays).

question_en: Who is the Chairman of ISRO?
explanation_en: V. Narayanan took charge in January 2025, succeeding S. Somanath.

question_en: NISAR, launched in July 2025 on a GSLV-F16 rocket, is a joint earth-observation satellite of ISRO and:
explanation_en: NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar maps Earth's land and ice changes with dual-frequency L and S band radar.

question_en: Operation Sindoor, launched on 7 May 2025, was India's military response to which attack?
explanation_en: India struck terror infrastructure in Pakistan and PoK after the 22 April 2025 Pahalgam attack on tourists.

question_en: Who is the Chief of the Naval Staff of the Indian Navy (as of 2026)?
explanation_en: Admiral Dinesh Kumar Tripathi took over as Navy chief on 30 April 2024.

question_en: 'Mission Sudarshan Chakra', announced by PM Modi on Independence Day 2025, is aimed at building:
explanation_en: The mission envisages an indigenous multi-layered air defence system to protect strategic and civilian sites by 2035.

question_en: INS Mangrol, commissioned in October 2026, is which type of Indian Navy vessel?
explanation_en: INS Mangrol is the third ASW Shallow Water Craft built in India (the Mahe class) and was commissioned on 12 October 2026.

question_en: Who received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award announced in September 2025, India's highest cinema honour?
explanation_en: Malayalam superstar Mohanlal received the award for 2023 at the 71st National Film Awards ceremony.

question_en: The 2025 Booker Prize was won by David Szalay for which novel?
explanation_en: Hungarian-British author David Szalay won the 2025 Booker Prize (announced November 2025) for 'Flesh'.

question_en: The Nobel Prize in Literature 2025 was awarded to which Hungarian author?
explanation_en: The Swedish Academy honoured Laszlo Krasznahorkai in October 2025 for his compelling and visionary oeuvre.

question_en: Navtej Sarna won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 (English), announced in March 2026, for which novel?
explanation_en: Former diplomat Navtej Sarna won for 'Crimson Spring', a novel on the 1919 Jallianwala Bagh massacre.

question_en: The Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in Hindi (announced March 2026) went to Mamta Kalia for her memoir:

options.en: Bahut Door Kitna Door Hota Hai

explanation_en: Mamta Kalia received the Rs 1 lakh award for the memoir 'Jeete Jee Allahabad'.

question_en: Runa Khan, a 2026 Ramon Magsaysay Award winner announced on 31 August 2026, is from which country?
explanation_en: The 2026 awardees: Tommy Koh (Singapore), Runa Khan (Bangladesh) and Bo Kyi (Myanmar).

question_en: Who won the FIDE Women's Chess World Cup in July 2025, also earning the Grandmaster title?
explanation_en: Teenager Divya Deshmukh beat Koneru Humpy in an all-Indian final at Batumi, Georgia, becoming India's 88th Grandmaster.
